text:
jordan: Quick postmortem follow-up from PM-238. We have two recurring patterns (prefetch eviction spikes, and short-lived 500 storms). Need: clearer escalation lanes, a tiny triage cuecard, and explicit remediation ownership for recurring patterns.

kate: Agree. The current playbook is long; we should add a "fast path" summary at the top for SRE on-call.

sam: I'll own the eviction-pattern remediation work. Planning to triage traces + workspace snapshots. ETA: EOD Wednesday.

leo: I can do the playbook edits (short cuecard + commands). Will add a small section with the exact commands we use during triage.

maria: For escalation lanes: propose 1) on-call (pager) -> 2) runtime eng (if GPU/runtime) -> 3) infra (if infra root cause) -> 4) exec if P0 > 30m. Shall I add to the flow diagram?

jordan: yes please add that order and also include contact rotation links. Keep it compact so people can skim mid-incident.

leo: Draft cuecard snippet I plan to insert (feedback welcome):
```
1) Check metrics: tokens/sec, queue depth, evictions (metric: runtime.evictions.count)
2) Run quick PID check: `kubectl top pod -l app=runtime -n inference`
3) If evictions > threshold, run eviction debug: `curl -s http://localhost:8080/debug/evictions`
4) If 500s rise and rollout active -> rollback to previous model variant
5) Escalate per lane: on-call -> runtime -> infra
```

kate: That looks great. Add a short bullet for when to flip autoscaler to conservative mode (`/infra autoscale set conservative`) and when to enable traffic-shed.

sam: Action items from thread: 1) sam: remediation plan and runbook steps for eviction pattern (EOD Wed). 2) leo: add cuecard + command snippets to playbook (tomorrow). 3) maria: update escalation diagram + contact links (Friday). 4) kate: add autoscale/traffic-shed bullets and small troubleshooting checklist (tomorrow).

incident-bot: Created ticket PM-238-REM-1 assigned to sam, due 2026-03-25.

jordan: I'll follow up on Friday with status and will slot a 30-min sync if any blockers. If someone finishes early, drop a short note in #incidents.

maria: One more: let's add a recurring detection rule to surface the eviction pattern earlier (alert group: inference.eviction-patterns), I'll draft the alert and share.

sam: Noted. Will include required logs and repro steps in the remediation ticket so it's actionable.

leo: After edits, I'll ping everyone for a quick sanity check. Plan to keep the cuecard <= 6 lines.

kate: :thumbsup: thanks all — small, actionable edits here will save time on next incident.

jordan: Thanks team — closing the thread for now, will reopen if anything slips.
